name: model_op_flash_attn
description: Flash attention forward with GQA, BNSD layout (FlagTree test/CommonIR/Ascend/success_case/fa_triton_arch.py::flash_attention_fwd). q [B, Hq, S, 64] float16/bfloat16, k and v [B, Hkv, S, 64] with Hq divisible by Hkv so each KV head is shared by Hq/Hkv query heads; combine_batch is the number of KV blocks fused per task (a scheduling knob that does not change the result); is_causal selects the lower-triangular mask q_index >= kv_index. Softmax scale is sqrt(1/head_dim), i.e. (1.0 / D) ** 0.5, applied to the raw QK scores before the row max is taken. Returns out [B, Hq, S, 64] with q's dtype. head_dim is fixed at 64 and S must be a multiple of the 32-element block size. Inputs are not modified.
